scope: Phase A read-only production DDR protocol audit; only this report is authored
repository: No Git repository; git status --short --branch failed with not a git repository

primary_manual.method: pdftotext -layout to stdout; visually inspected physical PDF pages 23-24 (printed pages 19-20) using pdftoppm
primary_manual.version_limit: Manual predates generated IP build 2026-03-25, TD 6.2.168116, IP generation version 168007 2025/07/10. Document-to-build behavior needs vendor simulation.

findings.derivation: One rank, 2 bank bits, 13 row bits, 10 column bits, 16 DQ bits: 2^(2+13+10)*16/8 = 67108864 bytes (64 MiB). PH1P_COMP_DENSITY=512 means Mb per manual configuration section, not MB.
findings.limit: No board identity/physical alias/address walking evidence; cannot mark physical capacity acceptance passed. Tentative arena ends exactly at capacity and must remain end-exclusive.

findings.conversion: paxi_addr = byte_addr >> 1 for this x16/128-bit-user configuration; require byte alignment and burst alignment separately
evidence: IPUG034 printed p18 table 2-17: 128-bit user data maps axi_axaddr={paxi_axaddr,1'b0}
IPUG034 printed p14 table 2-10: DDR2 ROW_COL_BANK maps row=A[24:12], col={A[11:5],A[2:0]}, bank=A[4:3]
findings.limit: Table heading says DQ Bytes * 8 although rows are 64/128/256/512; reconcile against generated 25-bit MC versus 26-bit AXI and explicit SDRAM column mapping. This is stronger than the prior +8 inference but still not board mapping acceptance.

evidence: IPUG034 printed p19 figure 2-17: one addr and one data transfer with RLAST
IPUG034 printed p20 figure 2-18: two addresses, two data transfers, RLAST asserted on both
findings.limit: axi_awlen/arlen in generic generated wrapper are inside optional AXI control branch, not this active PAXI interface. Do not reserve 4/8 returns from one PAXI AR; a 4/8-beat software group emits 4/8 addresses.

findings.rule: Require A[2:0]=0 for full BL8 accesses. Consecutive PAXI starts A,A+8,... are distinct linear 16-byte blocks even though ROW_COL_BANK stripes banks. 64/128-byte alignment is an optional DMA grouping restriction, not documented PAXI ARLEN behavior. Never change physical BL8 to BL4 by merely incrementing address by 4.
findings.limit: Unaligned low address bit behavior, burst wrap, bank/row transitions and final capacity boundary need vendor model or board readback. Physical BL4 is not selected and is outside current configuration.

findings.conclusion: Real WREADY exists. Upstream reports AWREADY as W-data-ready, and read FIFO pop simplifies to AWREADY regardless of ARREADY. The exact RTL expression (ARREADY || AWREADY) && AWREADY equals AWREADY. Lost acceptance remains a real risk, but arbitrary standard-AXI timing is not the correct vendor contract.
findings.vendor_constraint: Manual explicitly limits W data presentation to at most 2 clocks after write address. It illustrates simultaneous and delayed W; does not license W-before-AW or unbounded AW-to-W separation. New adapter must buffer data before AW issue, track actual AW/W acceptance, and satisfy or formally clarify this bounded relationship.
findings.mask_note: paxi_wstrb is HIGH-active MASK per manual p13 table 2-9, not ordinary AXI byte-enable semantics. Existing zero mask enables all bytes; partial writes must invert enabled-byte mask.

findings.conclusion: alc_mc_top exposes 2-bit paxi_bresp, paxi_bvalid and paxi_bready. ph1p_ddrmc_top discards BRESP/BVALID and ties BREADY=1; all higher wrappers omit B. The public manual PAXI table/timing omits B and no plaintext writecomplete definition was found. Do not claim the controller lacks B, and do not interpret B as physical completion without a contract.
findings.required_publication_definition: READY requires all 442368 payload bytes accepted plus a vendor-proven event guaranteeing subsequent slot reads observe all those writes; no failed response and no cancel/epoch mismatch. Whether B supplies this event is unknown. FIFO empty, last AW/W handshake, last video address update and fixed wait are insufficient.
findings.missing_evidence: A build-matched Anlogic PAXI write-response/read-after-write ordering specification or vendor-confirmed simulator trace demonstrating the fence. No known supplied filename defines writecomplete; do not invent one. NORMAL reorder prevents assuming an unrelated sentinel read fences earlier writes.

findings.conclusion: RLAST is available through ddr2 but not assigned to O_mc_app_rd_data_end; bridge ignores its input. Present bridge has no owner/epoch/reservation storage. Current top shares S_rst_n between bridge and DDR IP, but future CNN-only cancellation/reset cannot clear accepted ownership while DDR continues.
findings.reset_rule: Document says sys_rst_n resets PLL and other modules then reinitializes; it gives no bounded last-response flush guarantee. Preserve outstanding owners across local cancel, discard cancelled returns while retiring reservations, release slot only after last response. A global restart requires coordinated stop/reset/reinitialization and no old response acceptance before new epoch issuance, measured with reset-in-flight cases. No N-cycle drain assumption.

minimum_isolated_repair_boundary.proposal: Use isolated copies of mc_to_user_interface and ph1p35_324_ddr_wrapper plus a test-only PAXI endpoint. First prove read acceptance independently, expose RLAST, preserve W data and actual channel acceptance, use correct active-high mask, and keep command/return ownership. Keep video ring and IP configuration unchanged.
minimum_isolated_repair_boundary.b_exposure_if_vendor_confirms: An isolated generated-IP copy must propagate B from ph1p_ddrmc_top through ph1p_ddrmc_wrapper_63f4ac254419, ddr2 and application wrapper. This crosses generated source boundaries and is a separate reviewed change; do not patch production generated IP in this audit.

simulation_requirements.bridge_only: mc_to_user_interface.v, application wrapper, user_source/ip_source/w155_d512_fifo/w155_d512_fifo.v and sibling soft_fifo_al_f58e8b3e1f3d.v (contains ram_infer_f58e8b3e1f3d), plus a deliberately controllable PAXI endpoint. Generated FIFO uses SHOW_AHEAD_EN=1, OUTREG_EN=NOREG, almost-full=500 for depth512. Such a mock verifies adapter safety only, not vendor ordering/completion.
simulation_requirements.actual_ip: Generated sim/fileset/fileset_mis.f lists exact RTL closure, include dirs and ROM. Substitute <mis_path> with the absolute ph1p35_ddr directory, retain generated defines DDR2_512M/DDR2_X16/DDR2_1066/PH1P35 and correct ddrphy_cfg_rom.txt. Include encrypted alc_mc_top_all.enc.sv and all listed PHY/PLL/init/FIFO RTL.
simulation_requirements.encrypted_model: alc_mc_top_all.enc.sv contains plaintext interface then IEEE protected implementation; key owners include Cadence, Mentor and Synopsys. Use a compatible licensed simulator/version selected by vendor; iverilog cannot establish real encrypted-core behavior. Xsim support is not established by these keys.
simulation_requirements.simulation_define_warning: Generated wrapper lines 8-12 use PH1P_MIS_SIM to select include-directory lookup. PH1P_DDRPHY_SIM independently selects model logic inside PHY and MC; the supplied fileset does not establish which vendor simulation harness should define it. Obtain the vendor harness/launch script before asserting a complete runnable full-IP command. Do not indiscriminately enable both macros.
simulation_requirements.missing_from_generated_sim: Only sim/fileset/fileset_mis.f exists; no simulation top/testbench or DDR2 physical memory model is supplied in this generated sim directory. Need a 512-Mbit x16 DDR2 behavioral model supporting configured CL7/BL8 and actual pin wiring, plus its timing include/config. Exact vendor memory part/model filename is not identified in checked files; must obtain it from board/vendor rather than guessing ddr2.v (that name already identifies the controller wrapper).
required_cases: WREADY differs from AWREADY under vendor-legal timing
AW-to-W 0/1/2 clocks and rejection of unsupported timing
single and continuous reads each exactly one RLAST beat
4/8 command groups, bank/row crossing, first/last arena addresses
write/read visibility under NORMAL reorder and confirmed B/fence meaning
local cancellation and global reset at every accepted/in-flight stage
reservation+occupancy never exceeds buffer depth; no old-epoch success
